name: svg-shapes-animated
title: Animated SVG Shapes
blurb: Library of animated SVG geometric shapes with stroke-drawing entrance effects.
description: A collection of 40+ animated SVG shape components (triangles, circles, stars, polygons, etc.) with stroke-based drawing animations. Each animates on scroll entrance and respects prefers-reduced-motion.
use_when: Decorative geometric elements with entrance animations or interactive line-drawing effects.
avoid_when: When you need filled shapes with complex gradients or when shapes need to be fully sized without parent constraints.
a11y: Decorative SVG elements without alt text or labels. Animation respects prefers-reduced-motion user preference.
